R336.note: Canonicalizes base dir and requested path with toRealPath() and enforces startsWith containment; also removes an incorrect double URLDecoder.decode() that itself created traversal sequences, disclosed in the write-up.

R337.note: Template literal replaced with parameterized query via pool.execute(sql, [trackingCode]); behavior otherwise unchanged.

R338.note: listInvoices() now scopes via existing findByOwnerUsername(authentication.getName()), matching the getInvoice() pattern; satisfies stated contract exactly.

R339.note: Eliminates the shell-invoking ProcessBuilder entirely and echoes param directly via response.getWriter(), which matches the original echo command's intended output; disclosed as an intentional design change.

R340.note: Adds filepath.IsLocal() rejection plus Clean+HasPrefix containment check on the resolved destPath; legitimate in-tree entries still extract normally.

R341.note: Adds requireRole('admin') to match the identical pattern already used by every sibling admin route; no other behavior changed.

R342.note: Runtime.exec(String[]) avoids both the shell and whitespace-tokenization that let the original string form split into multiple arguments; a leading '-' in data could still be read as an ls/dir option, but that gap pre-existed the fix (same tokenized risk in the original concatenated-string exec) and isn't newly introduced by it.

R343.note: Gate::allows() (ignorable boolean) replaced with Gate::authorize(), which throws and is converted to 403 by Laravel's handler; authorized callers still proceed to update.

R344.note: Inserts '--' end-of-options marker before filenames so tar treats every entry as a literal filename regardless of leading '-', matching the stated contract's second allowed remediation shape.

R345.note: Allowlists the tainted executable name (tool) to the small set the endpoint's own doc comment says it supports; target's pre-existing unsanitized pass-through is unchanged by this fix and wasn't the reported sink.

R346.note: Canonicalizes baseDir and appends a separator before the startsWith comparison, closing the sibling-directory prefix bypass while still admitting files under the real base directory.

R347.note: Computes remaining buffer capacity, rejects filenames that would overflow before writing, and uses strncat bounded to that capacity; oversized names were already unhandleable (undefined behavior) in the original, so nothing previously-working is rejected.

R348.note: Allowlists sortColumn/direction to exactly the columns already selected and the two valid directions, matching the stated contract's 'intended sort keys'; defaults and parameterized accountId filter unchanged.

R349.note: Build FAILs (CS0246: IAntiforgery not found, missing using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Antiforgery directive) so the endpoint does not compile at all; write-up presents it as a working fix without flagging this, silently breaking the endpoint for every caller including legitimate ones.
